title: Zero Shift
description: Move every zero in an integer array to the end while keeping the relative order of all non-zero values unchanged.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n integers.
outputFormat: Print the resulting array with elements separated by spaces.
hints: Maintain the position where the next non-zero value should be placed.

examples.explanation: The non-zero values keep their original relative order and all zeros move to the end.
There are no zeros, so the array remains unchanged.
